pairs.target: chūfā nàtiān , pà wò bǐ tǎ wéi xǐng dé hái zǎo .
pairs.english: On departure day, Pavo woke even earlier than Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 出发那天，帕沃比塔维醒得还早。

pairs.target: tā zuòzài chuángbiān , yìliǎn kùnjuàn dì kàn tǎ wéixì bāo , děng le bàntiān , zhōngyú wèn shèngxià de yóuzhǐ néng bunéng liúgěi zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Sitting sleepily on his bed, he watched Tavi tie his bag for a long time, then finally asked whether he could have the leftover oiled paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐在床边，一脸困倦地看塔维系包，等了半天，终于问剩下的油纸能不能留给自己。

pairs.target: tā de xiédǐ kāi le , jīntiān yào ná qù bǔ , bùxiǎng yílù bǎ ní diào zài rénjiā dìshàng .
pairs.english: His sole had come loose; he was taking the shoe for repair today and didn't want to scatter mud on the repairer's floor.
pairs.hanzi: 他的鞋底开了，今天要拿去补，不想一路把泥掉在人家地上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yóuzhǐ dìguòqù , hūrán juéde zuówǎn nà diǎn zhèngzhòng báifèi le .
pairs.english: Tavi handed it over and suddenly felt last night's solemnity had been wasted.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把油纸递过去，忽然觉得昨晚那点郑重白费了。

pairs.target: tā běnlái hái xiǎng shuō jǐjù xiàngyàng de gàobié huà , jiéguǒ liǎnggè rén dūn zài dìshàng , bǎ yìzhī pòxié bāo dé xiàng yào sònglǐ .
pairs.english: He had meant to make a proper farewell speech; instead they crouched together, wrapping a broken shoe as though it were a gift.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来还想说几句像样的告别话，结果两个人蹲在地上，把一只破鞋包得像要送礼。

pairs.target: yīwén zài ménwài děng , mǐlā zhī láidejí cóng lóushàng tàn chūtóu .
pairs.english: Iven waited outside. Mira only had time to lean out from upstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在门外等，米拉只来得及从楼上探出头。

pairs.target: tā shàngwǔ yào hé sū yǐ liáng yìzhī zhuāngmǎn shī shā de mùhé , jiào tǎ wéi huílái yǐhòu biéwàngle wèn jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: She and Suyi would measure a wooden box filled with wet sand that morning; she told him not to forget to ask the result on his return.
pairs.hanzi: 她上午要和苏苡量一只装满湿沙的木盒，叫塔维回来以后别忘了问结果。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎngtóu dāying , chàdiǎn zhuàng dào yīwén shēn lái de bǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up to promise and nearly collided with the flatbread Iven was offering.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维仰头答应，差点撞到伊文伸来的饼。

pairs.target: tāmen zǒu dào nán ménwài de chēpéng .
pairs.english: They walked to the wagon shelter outside the south gate.
pairs.hanzi: 他们走到南门外的车棚。

pairs.target: xià píng mǎtóu de hé chéngchē yǐjīng tào hǎo shēngkǒu , chēwěi bǎng zhe jǐzhī kōng kuāng , qiántou pù le liǎngpái zhǎi mùbǎn .
pairs.english: The shared wagon to Flat Landing was harnessed, empty baskets tied at the back and two rows of narrow planks at the front.
pairs.hanzi: 下平码头的合乘车已经套好牲口，车尾绑着几只空筐，前头铺了两排窄木板。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gěi chēfū kàn piào , àn zhǐdiǎn zuò dào kào lǐ de wèizhì , bǎ bāo bào zài xī shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi showed the driver his ticket, sat farther inside as directed, and held his bag on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维给车夫看票，按指点坐到靠里的位置，把包抱在膝上。

pairs.target: yīwén gé zhe chē lán dìjìn yì xiǎozhāng zhǐ . shàngmiàn shì tā zuówǎn zhòngchāo de lùkǒu míngzì ,
pairs.english: Iven handed a small slip through the rail. It listed junction names he had copied the night before,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文隔着车栏递进一小张纸。上面是他昨晚重抄的路口名字，

pairs.target: méiyǒu huà yìtiáo tōngwǎng shénme dìfāng dōu zhèngquè de xiàn . "
pairs.english: Without a line pretending to be the right route everywhere.
pairs.hanzi:
没有画一条通往什么地方都正确的线。
“

pairs.target: rènbùchū jiù wèn . " tā shuō , " wǒ huà de yě yào wèn . "
pairs.english: “Ask when you can't recognize something,” he said. “Ask about my drawing too.”
pairs.hanzi: 认不出就问。”他说，“我画的也要问。”

pairs.target: chēfū cuī zhàn zài wàimiàn de rén rànglù . yīwén pāilepāi chē lán , wǎng hòutuì le liǎngbù .
pairs.english: The driver urged those outside to clear the way. Iven patted the rail and stepped back.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫催站在外面的人让路。伊文拍了拍车栏，往后退了两步。

pairs.target: chē yídòng , tǎ wéi cái jímáng shuō huíjiàn , shēngyīn bèi lúnzǐ niǎn shí de xiǎngdòng yā diào yíbàn .
pairs.english: Only when the wagon moved did Tavi hastily call goodbye, half his words drowned by wheels grinding stone.
pairs.hanzi: 车一动，塔维才急忙说回见，声音被轮子碾石的响动压掉一半。

pairs.target: yīwén méi tīng qīng , háishì cháo tā huī le shǒu .
pairs.english: Iven did not hear clearly but waved anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没听清，还是朝他挥了手。

pairs.target: zuìchū de lù tā rènde . mài tàn de péngzǐ , xiū lúnzǐ de pùmiàn , yìcéngcéng tuì dào chē hòu .
pairs.english: At first he knew the road. Coal sheds and wheelwrights' shops receded behind the wagon.
pairs.hanzi: 最初的路他认得。卖炭的棚子、修轮子的铺面，一层层退到车后。

pairs.target: guò le chàkǒu , chē wǎng tā méi zǒuguò de nánpō rào qù ,
pairs.english: Past the fork, they curved onto an unfamiliar southern slope.
pairs.hanzi: 过了岔口，车往他没走过的南坡绕去，

pairs.target: tóng jiē chéng de zhōnglóu hái lù zhe dǐng , jiànjiàn bèi jìnchù de shān jiān zhēzhù .
pairs.english: Copperstep's bell tower still showed its top, then gradually vanished behind the nearer mountain shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 铜阶城的钟楼还露着顶，渐渐被近处的山肩遮住。

pairs.target: lùpáng yǒu xīn bǔ de dǎngqiáng , shífèng lǐ de huījiāng yánsè hěn qiǎn .
pairs.english: A newly patched retaining wall lined the road, its mortar pale between the stones.
pairs.hanzi: 路旁有新补的挡墙，石缝里的灰浆颜色很浅。

pairs.target: chēfū zài yíchù zhuǎnwān qián xiàchē , qiān zhe shēngkǒu mànmàn zǒu ,
pairs.english: Before one bend the driver dismounted and led the animals slowly,
pairs.hanzi: 车夫在一处转弯前下车，牵着牲口慢慢走，

pairs.target: hòulún páng chuí xià de mùzhì chà kuài cā zhe tiěquān , fāchū chángchángde zhīshēng .
pairs.english: A wooden brake block hanging beside the rear wheel scraped its iron rim with a long squeal.
pairs.hanzi: 后轮旁垂下的木制刹块擦着铁圈，发出长长的吱声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiàyìshí bēngjǐn tuǐ , zuòzài duìmiàn de lǎotóu què bǎ màozi lā dào yǎnjīng shàng , jìxù dǎdǔn .
pairs.english: Tavi instinctively tensed his legs, while the old man opposite pulled his hat over his eyes and kept dozing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维下意识绷紧腿，坐在对面的老头却把帽子拉到眼睛上，继续打盹。

pairs.target: guǎiguòqù yǐhòu , shù hūrán shǎo le , pō xià lùchū yípiàn zhěngqí de lǜ .
pairs.english: Beyond the bend the trees suddenly thinned, revealing orderly green plots down the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 拐过去以后，树忽然少了，坡下露出一片整齐的绿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qǐxiān zhī kànjiàn càiqí , jiēzhe kànjiàn ǎiqiáng , jǐkuài shībù zài zhúgān shàng fāndòng .
pairs.english: First Tavi saw vegetable beds, then low walls and damp cloths fluttering on bamboo poles.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维起先只看见菜畦，接着看见矮墙，几块湿布在竹竿上翻动。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ túcè lǐ de jiù pǔ jiē , wèn chēfū zhè shìbushì nà dìfāng .
pairs.english: Remembering Old Garden Street in the charts, he asked the driver if this was it.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起图册里的旧圃街，问车夫这是不是那地方。

pairs.target: chēfū shuō shì jiù pǔ zhè yídài , jiē zǎo búshì yǐqián de jiē , zhòngcài de rén hái yòng nàge míngzì jiào zhàn kǒu . "
pairs.english: The driver said it was the Old Garden area; the street had changed, but the gardeners still called the stop by that name.
pairs.hanzi:
车夫说是旧圃这一带，街早不是以前的街，种菜的人还用那个名字叫站口。
“

pairs.target: jǐng ne ? " " nǐ yào hēshuǐ ? " " búshì . wǒ jiàn guò yìzhāng jiù huà . "
pairs.english: “What about the well?” “Need a drink?” “No. I've seen an old picture.”
pairs.hanzi:
井呢？”
“你要喝水？”
“不是。我见过一张旧画。”

pairs.target: chēfū xiào le , shuō jǐng duō le , bù zhīdào tā huà shàng nǎ yìkǒu .
pairs.english: The driver laughed: there were plenty of wells; he did not know which one was in the picture.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫笑了，说井多了，不知道他画上哪一口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào , jiāng běnzi ná chūlái , zài lùkǒu míngzì xiàmiàn tiān le " càidì " liǎnggè zì , méiyǒu tiān jǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled too, took out his notebook and added “vegetable plots” below the junction's name. He did not add a well.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑，将本子拿出来，在路口名字下面添了“菜地”两个字，没有添井。

pairs.target: zhōngtú xiējiǎo shí , dàjiā xiàchē huódòng tuǐ .
pairs.english: At a rest stop, everyone climbed down to stretch their legs.
pairs.hanzi: 中途歇脚时，大家下车活动腿。

pairs.target: mài dòu tāng de péngzǐ dā zài bèifēngchù , guō lǐ fú zhe qièsuì de cōng .
pairs.english: A bean-soup stall stood out of the wind, chopped scallions floating in the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 卖豆汤的棚子搭在背风处，锅里浮着切碎的葱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi duānwǎn zhàn zhe , wàngjiàn yuǎnchù yíxiàn shuǐ guāng , yǐwéi yǐjīng dào le hébiān .
pairs.english: Holding his bowl, Tavi saw a distant gleam of water and thought they had reached the river.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维端碗站着，望见远处一线水光，以为已经到了河边。

pairs.target: péng zhǔ shuō , hái dé xiàqù liǎnggè dà wān , yǎnjīng zǒu dé bǐ chē kuài .
pairs.english: The stallkeeper said there were two big bends still to descend: eyes travelled faster than wagons.
pairs.hanzi: 棚主说，还得下去两个大弯，眼睛走得比车快。

pairs.target: chē zài kāishí , tā méi zài bàojǐn bāo , gǎi bǎ bāo dài rào zài shǒuwàn shàng , téngchū yìzhī shǒufú chē lán .
pairs.english: When they moved again, he no longer clutched his bag; he looped the strap around his wrist, freeing one hand for the rail.
pairs.hanzi: 车再开时，他没再抱紧包，改把包带绕在手腕上，腾出一只手扶车栏。

pairs.target: shānjiān de shuǐ guāng shíyǐnshíxiàn , mànmàn biànkuān .
pairs.english: The water flickered between the mountains, slowly widening.
pairs.hanzi: 山间的水光时隐时现，慢慢变宽。

pairs.target: dào le pōdǐ , kōngqì lǐ búzài zhǐyǒu shífěn hé shēngkǒu de qìwèi , hái hùn zhe cháoshī de mùtou , làn yè hé zhǔ yú de wèidào .
pairs.english: At the bottom, the air held not just stone dust and animals, but wet wood, rotting leaves and cooking fish.
pairs.hanzi: 到了坡底，空气里不再只有石粉和牲口的气味，还混着潮湿的木头、烂叶和煮鱼的味道。

pairs.target: píng mǎtóu bǐ tā xiǎng de dà .
pairs.english: Flat Landing was larger than he expected.
pairs.hanzi: 平码头比他想的大。

pairs.target: hé bù tiēzhe lù zǒu , héng zài qiánmiàn , xiàng yǒurén bǎ yuǎnchù nàtiáo xìxiàn chěkāi le .
pairs.english: The river did not follow the road but stretched across its end, as though someone had pulled that distant thin line wide open.
pairs.hanzi: 河不贴着路走，横在前面，像有人把远处那条细线扯开了。

pairs.target: jǐtiáo chuán bìngpái tíng zhe , ànbiān yǒurén káng mádài , yě yǒurén līn zhe liǎngzhī huó yā zhēnglùn jiàqián .
pairs.english: Boats lay side by side; on shore people shouldered sacks or haggled over two live ducks.
pairs.hanzi: 几条船并排停着，岸边有人扛麻袋，也有人拎着两只活鸭争论价钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài chē páng , hūrán bù zhīdào gāi xiān kàn nǎbiān .
pairs.english: Beside the wagon, Tavi suddenly did not know where to look first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在车旁，忽然不知道该先看哪边。

pairs.target: chēfū tì tā cóng zuò xià gōuchū diàojìnqù de shǒupà , jiào tā bié guāng kàn chuán , bāo yě dé kàn .
pairs.english: The driver fished his fallen handkerchief from under the seat and told him to watch his bag, not just the boats.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫替他从座下勾出掉进去的手帕，叫他别光看船，包也得看。

pairs.target: tā dào le xiè , zhǎodào chuán xíng de xiǎowū , ná piào wèn míngzǎo cóng nǎ kuài tiàobǎn shàngchuán .
pairs.english: He thanked him, found the boat company's hut, and showed his ticket to ask which gangplank to use tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他道了谢，找到船行的小屋，拿票问明早从哪块跳板上船。

pairs.target: guǎnshì ràng tā rèn ménbiān de lán qī zhù , yòu zhǐchū gébì néng zhù yíyè de kèshè .
pairs.english: The attendant pointed out the blue-painted post by the door, then the neighbouring guesthouse for the night.
pairs.hanzi: 管事让他认门边的蓝漆柱，又指出隔壁能住一夜的客舍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu guòqù , xiān wèn le jià hé wūlǐ yǒu jǐzhāng chuáng , cái bǎ bāo fàngxià .
pairs.english: Tavi went over and asked the price and number of beds before putting his bag down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走过去，先问了价和屋里有几张床，才把包放下。

pairs.target: yèlǐ , tóngwū de rén zǎozǎo shuì le , yǒurén fānshēn shí pèng dé chuángjià qīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: That night his roommates slept early; a bedframe clicked when someone turned over.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里，同屋的人早早睡了，有人翻身时碰得床架轻响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng le yíhuìer , qǐshēn tuīkāi yìdiǎn chuāng .
pairs.english: After listening awhile, Tavi rose and opened the window a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听了一会儿，起身推开一点窗。

pairs.target: hémiàn hēi dé kànbújiàn biān , ànbiān de dēng dǎoyìng xiàqù , bèi shuǐ chāichéng yìjié yijié , zěnme yě hé bùchéng wánzhěng de yìzhǎn .
pairs.english: The river was too dark to see its edges. Reflected shore lamps broke into pieces on the water, never quite becoming one whole light.
pairs.hanzi: 河面黑得看不见边，岸边的灯倒映下去，被水拆成一节一节，怎么也合不成完整的一盏。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng bǎ zhè yíkè jiǎng gěi yīwén tīng , yòu xiǎngdào yīwén dàgài zǎo kànguò .
pairs.english: He wanted to tell Iven about this moment, then thought Iven had probably seen it already.
pairs.hanzi: 他想把这一刻讲给伊文听，又想到伊文大概早看过。

pairs.target: tā réng cóng bāo lǐ náchū běnzi , xiě le jǐjù . xiě wán , méiyǒu huàdiào .
pairs.english: He took out his notebook anyway and wrote a few lines. When he finished, he did not cross them out.
pairs.hanzi: 他仍从包里拿出本子，写了几句。写完，没有划掉。
